about: Resources shown in the Resursi tab of the LenaAI skills screen for the files in this folder. Keys name a file in this folder (AGENT.md, skills/*.md). Each entry is a legal source ({"type": "legal", "id"} from agents/lena/legal-sources.json), a web page ({"type": "link", "title", "url"}), a screen of this app ({"type": "app", "title", "view"}) or a JSON data file of the backend under resources/lena or agents/lena ({"type": "file", "title", "path"}). Resources never enter the prompt.
